_meta.purpose: Hadith records used in Fitrah. Each record names the collection, the number and the edition it was entered from.
_meta.rule: Never type hadith text from memory. Enter the Arabic text, an attributed translation and the grading from a named edition, then record the reviewer's sign-off. Until then `arabic` stays null and the reference is shown as provisional.

summary.ar: يذكر الحديث أن الإسلام بُني على خمسة أركان: الشهادتان، وإقام الصلاة، وإيتاء الزكاة، وصوم رمضان، وحج البيت.
summary.en: The hadith says Islam is built on five pillars: the testimony of faith, prayer, zakah, fasting in Ramadan, and pilgrimage to the House.
